Description

Requiem for the dead. Nightmare for the living.
A new era of survival horror arrives with Resident Evil Requiem, the latest and most immersive entry yet in the iconic Resident Evil series.

Experience terrifying survival horror with FBI analyst Grace Ashcroft, and dive into pulse-pounding action with legendary agent Leon S. Kennedy. Both of their journeys and unique gameplay styles intertwine into a heart-stopping, emotional experience that will chill you to your core.

Raccoon City
Return once again to the city of disaster and despair.

A midwestern city in the United States and the headquarters for the former global pharmaceutical company, Umbrella.

In the face of the zombie outbreak in 1998, the government approved a sterilization operation, a missile strike on the city in an attempt to quickly bring the situation under control—but this was swiftly covered up.

Grace Ashcroft
An intelligence analyst for the FBI who demonstrates intense focus and insight in deductive reasoning and analysis. Her mother's death shook her to the soul, making her an introvert who immerses herself in work. So she heads to the abandoned hotel alone to investigate this mysterious death.

Leon S. Kennedy
One of the survivors of the Raccoon City Incident. With a strong sense of justice and physical capabilities to match, he has responded to numerous outbreaks since that fateful day. Now, as a seasoned DSO agent combatting bioterrorism, he has returned to investigate the latest string of deaths in the Midwest.

Gameplay
Experience the series' classic survival horror through combat, investigations, puzzles, and resource management. Gameplay allows you to freely switch between first and third-person views to face the horrors in a way that suits your playstyle.

    9/10

    I loved Resident Evil Requiem, and can't stop thinking about it. The perfect blend of horror and action, shared between the dual protagonists of Grace and Leon was a treat. The surprises that await are a delight, and each location is equally terrifying as it is exciting.


    For Grace, the puzzles are engaging, and the enemies are extremely immersive with their terrifying mutterings as they shuffle through darkened hallways.


    When it comes to Leon, it's a blast. It's so great to see Capcom give equal playtime to both characters, and Leon really gets his chapters to shine as an action hero, and it's oh so fun.


    This is a Resident Evil game I'd play through again just to see how fast I can complete it, while experiencing the thrills all over again.

    After nearly 30 years of playing Resident Evil, I can honestly say that Resident Evil Requiem feels like the emotional payoff the series has been building toward since the nightmare of 1998.


    The gameplay feels incredible from the start, especially for fans of the Resident Evil 4 Remake. Combat is smooth, exploration is tense, and the ability to switch between first-person and the classic over-the-shoulder third-person perspective makes the experience feel both modern and nostalgic at the same time.


    Capcom also introduced a new protagonist, Grace Ashcroft. Daughter of an OG Raccoon City Outbreak survivor, Alyssa Ashcroft. and she quickly became a standout character in the series. Her story is emotional and deeply human, and the voice performance behind her is absolutely phenomenal. For the first time in my history with Resident Evil, a character’s story genuinely made me cry.


    Then there’s Leon S. Kennedy. Watching his journey come full circle back to the horrors that started it all is incredibly powerful for longtime fans. Seeing him finally confront Umbrella’s legacy and close that chapter of his life feels like the ending we’ve been waiting decades to witness.


    Powered by the RE Engine, the game looks stunning. The atmosphere is dark and terrifying, the environments are beautifully detailed, and the infected enemies are more horrifying than ever.


    With two unique protagonists, strong replayability, and a gripping story, Resident Evil Requiem perfectly balances survival horror and action.


    10/10 – A must-play for every Resident Evil fan and a great introduction for newcomers that are curious about the RE Universe.

    I’ll leave you with the optimistically ominous words of a Legacy, Raccoon City, Survivor…


    “This time… it has to be different.”

    — Leon S. Kennedy 🎮
